           TRITICUM REPENS-AGROPYRON REPENS

         Couch-Grass

        (TRITICUM)



An excellent remedy in excessive irritability of the bladder, dysuria,
        cystitis, gonorrhœa.



Nose.--  Always blowing nose.



Urinary.--  Frequent,   difficult  ,
        and painful urination (  Pop  ). Gravelly deposits.
        Catarrhal and purulent discharges (  Pareira  ). Strangury,
        pyelitis; enlarged prostate. Chronic cystic irritability. Incontinence; constant desire.
        Urine is dense and causes irritation of the mucous surfaces.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Tradescantia  ;
        (Hæmorrhage from ear and upper air passages; painful urination, urethral discharge; scrotum
        inflamed).   Chimaph; Senecio; Populus trem; Buchu; Uva  .



Polytrichum Juniperinum  -Ground Moss--(Painful urination of old
        people; dropsy, urinary obstruction and suppression).



Dose.--  Tincture or infusion by boiling two ounces in a quart
        of water until it is reduced to a pint. To be taken in four doses in 24 hours.
